I've read the transcript, the answer key, and the eight record items, and matched them up.

**Pairings:** rec 1→e1, rec 2→e2, rec 3→a1, rec 4→a3, rec 5→i6, rec 6→i3, rec 8→i2. Key items e3, a2, i1, i4, i5, i7 have no counterpart in the record. Record item 7 is left over.

**Notable findings:**
- The record caught the two corrected figures it does carry correctly ($1.2M contract, $24,500 deferral) and avoided the superseded $150,000 salary / $37,500 / $62,000 trio.
- But a1 is badly thinned: no $33,000 employer piece, no $57,500 total, no payroll timing. The $200,000 cash move (a2) is missing entirely, as is the whole document package (i1), the pension estimate (i4), the projection rerun (i5), Owen's college timeline (e3), and Devin's covenant read (i7).
- Record 6 names the CPA "Jonas Pelletier" — the meeting explicitly corrected this to **Peltier** at [00:11:30]. Not a figure, so I scored figures as clean, but flagged it.
- Record 7 is the leftover: it splits the "deferral starts with the October 30 payroll" clause out of the Jonas item (i3), assigns it to Anneliese — the exact owner the meeting *removed* at [00:24:41]–[00:25:26] — and treats the payroll run date as a due date.
- All four NOT ACTIONS were correctly kept out of the record.

key_items.note: Captures the Brantmoor Regional Health signing at $1.2 million total, which matches [00:02:36]. Omits the milestone billing structure and the ~$180,000 first milestone in November 2026, but carries no incorrect figure.
Project engineer hire in February 2027 matches [00:03:06]/[00:03:27]. Drops the $95,000-$100,000 salary range and the 'first full-time W-2 employee' framing, but states no wrong figure.
Not captured. Owen's senior year, the two early action applications due November 1 [00:01:00] and the fall 2027 college start are absent from the record entirely.

Pairs on the solo 401(k) setup with the $24,500 deferral, which is the final correct figure and survives the salary correction at [00:19:07]. Materially incomplete though: no Pellrose custodian, no sponsor name, no $33,000 employer profit-sharing (25% of the corrected $132,000 W-2), no $57,500 2026 total, no October/November/December payroll funding or pre-tax election. Scored true because every figure present is right.

Not captured. The $200,000 move from the Marrowgate operating account to a government money market fund in a new corporate brokerage account at Pellrose, agreed at [00:17:30]-[00:17:46] and authorized on the account application [00:18:54], is missing.

Pairs on discontinuing the SEP. Amount NOT_FOUND is appropriate since no money moves. Omits the detail that it requires a letter to Pellrose plus a written participant notice and that the SEP IRA stays open with no 2026 contribution, but carries no wrong figure.

Not captured. Devin's e-signature package due Tuesday the 22nd [00:14:40]-[00:15:02] - adoption agreement, Pellrose plan application, deferral election, SEP discontinuance letter and participant notice, brokerage application and corporate resolution - has no record item.

Owner Devin Oakes and due 2026-10-01 both match [00:24:02]. No figures carried, so figures pass by default; the $1,000,000/$1,500,000 amounts, 10- and 15-year terms, company ownership and the 101(j) notice-and-consent requirement are all dropped but not misstated.

Owner Marisol Tendry is the final assignment after the reassignment from Anneliese at [00:24:41]-[00:25:26], and due 2026-10-06 matches her CPA meeting. No figures carried, so figures pass. Flag: the record writes the CPA as 'Jonas Pelletier', which the meeting explicitly corrected to 'Peltier' at [00:11:30]; that is a name rather than a figure so it does not fail the figures check, but it is a recording error.
Not captured. Graham's pension benefit estimate at age 61 via the member portal, moved from the 25th to October 9 at [00:28:12]-[00:28:16], has no record item.

Not captured. Anneliese's rerun of the projection at Marisol 58 / Graham 61 with $57,500 into the solo 401(k), due before the December 8 meeting [00:28:19], has no record item. Record 7 shares her name but covers different subject matter and is already accounted for as a duplicate of i3.
Owner Marisol Tendry and due 2026-09-21 both match [00:21:07]-[00:21:16]. No figures carried. 'For review' is a fair paraphrase of sending it to Devin.

Not captured. Devin's separate obligation to read the line of credit agreement for life insurance, collateral assignment or covenant requirements before the October 1 quotes return [00:21:10]/[00:21:16] is not a distinct record item; record 5 is Marisol's send task and is already paired to i6.

extra_items.note: Restates a clause already inside record 6. The meeting gave Jonas two jobs in one item at [00:24:59]: confirm the $132,000 and $33,000, and get the deferral set up to start with the October 30 payroll. Record 6 captures that item; record 7 splits the second half into a standalone task. It also gets the owner wrong - Anneliese explicitly handed this off to Marisol at [00:24:41] ('Don't send him the note... Let me take it to him') and Devin confirmed the reassignment at [00:25:21] - and it misuses the October 30 payroll date as a due date when the actual deadline was Marisol's October 6 CPA meeting.
